name: svg-shapes
blurb: 25 geometric and sacred-geometry SVG shapes for visual composition.
description: Reusable SVG panel and shape components including circles, polygons, wireframes, and fractal spirals.
use_when: Decorative panels, hero frames, or abstract geometric compositions.

a11y: Decorative SVG shapes only. No interactivity.
